messages.text: My sourdough starter smells like acetone. Is it dead?
Not dead, just hungry. An acetone or nail-polish smell means the yeast ran out of food. Discard most of it and feed with equal parts flour and water twice a day for two days.
Should I use rye flour for the feeding?
Rye helps because it has more minerals and wild yeast on the bran. A 50/50 rye and bread flour mix is a good recovery diet.
Why does the Rust borrow checker complain about mutable aliasing here?
You hold an immutable reference from `iter()` while calling `push`, which needs `&mut self`. Collect the indices first, then mutate.
Plan three days in Lisbon with pastel de nata stops.
Day one: Alfama and Manteigaria. Day two: Belém and the original Pastéis de Belém. Day three: LX Factory and a day trip to Sintra.
Give me the difference between ROW_NUMBER, RANK and DENSE_RANK.
ROW_NUMBER is always unique. RANK leaves gaps after ties. DENSE_RANK does not leave gaps.
